title: batch decision request
description: Explicit ids only; there is no "all" form. itemEtags is a JSON object keyed by itemId, so a duplicate id cannot be expressed (the server rejects duplicate member names with 400). Every id must belong to the path syllabus and owner; others yield per-item not_found. approve is accepted only for resolved looks_right items of a document with batchApproveAllowed (batch_not_eligible).
